description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Order to vest the premises of Walasmulla Bus Stand and Old Commercial Complex with the Urban Development Authority w.e.f. 02.11.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the vesting of land (Bus Stand and Old Commercial Complex premises) from Weeraketiya Pradeshiya Sabha to the Urban Development Authority. The content includes detailed land description, boundaries, extent measurements, and survey details, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core land transfer action and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification.
